verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an observability and evaluation platform, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question. A probe confirms an official first-party MCP server repository (langchain-ai/langsmith-mcp-server), but the pack says nothing about its tools, setup, auth or maturity. missing for 10: documentation of exposed MCP tools/resources, setup and auth instructions for connecting an agent, hosted-endpoint details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
